shortDescription: Publish a message to a RabbitMQ queue.

options.name: auto_delete
options.description: Set the queue to auto delete.

options.name: body
options.description: The body of the message. A C(body) cannot be provided if a C(src) is specified.

options.name: cafile
options.description: CA file used during connection to the RabbitMQ server over SSL. If this option is specified, also I(certfile) and I(keyfile) must be specified.

options.name: certfile
options.description: Client certificate to establish SSL connection. If this option is specified, also I(cafile) and I(keyfile) must be specified.

options.name: content_type
options.description: The content type of the body.

options.name: durable
options.description: Set the queue to be durable.

options.name: exchange
options.description: The exchange to publish a message to. An C(exchange) cannot be provided if a C(queue) is specified.

options.name: exclusive
options.description: Set the queue to be exclusive.

options.name: headers
options.description: A dictionary of headers to post with the message.

options.name: host
options.description: The RabbitMQ server hostname or IP.

options.name: keyfile
options.description: Client key to establish SSL connection. If this option is specified, also I(cafile) and I(certfile) must be specified.

options.name: password
options.description: The RabbitMQ password.

options.name: port
options.description: The RabbitMQ server port.

options.name: proto
options.description: The protocol to use.

options.name: queue
options.description: The queue to publish a message to.  If no queue is specified, RabbitMQ will return a random queue name. A C(queue) cannot be provided if an C(exchange) is specified.

options.name: routing_key
options.description: The routing key.

options.name: src
options.description: A file to upload to the queue.  Automatic mime type detection is attempted if content_type is not defined (left as default). A C(src) cannot be provided if a C(body) is specified. The filename is added to the headers of the posted message to RabbitMQ. Key being the C(filename), value is the filename.

options.name: url
options.description: An URL connection string to connect to the RabbitMQ server. I(url) and I(host)/I(port)/I(user)/I(pass)/I(vhost) are mutually exclusive, use either or but not both.

options.name: username
options.description: The RabbitMQ username.

options.name: vhost
options.description: The virtual host to target. If default vhost is required, use C('%2F').
